# Have we reached peak English in the world?

This article is more than 8 years old

Nicholas Ostler

One of Britain’s greatest strengths is set to diminish as China asserts itself on the world stage

Tue 27 Feb 2018 01.00 EST

Last modified on Tue 27 Feb 2018 08.01 EST

I n China last month, Theresa May attended the launch of the British Council’s English is Great campaign, intended to boost interest and fluency in our national language. This might sound like Donald Trump’s notorious “Make America great again”, but comes in fact from a stronger position. Beyond doubt, the use of English is greater than ever, and far more widespread than any other language in the world.
